items.item_text: 01. Which statement below best describes the highest level of education you have completed? Options: Some High School | High school graduate, diploma or the equivalent (GED) | Some college (less than 60 units) | Associate degree or at least 60 semester units | Bachelor's degree | Master's degree | Professional degree | Doctorate degree
02. Which positions are you interested in? (Select ALL that apply) Options: Clerk | Clerical Assistant I | Clerical Assistant II | Secretary

03. Are you interested in bilingual (English/Spanish) clerical positions? Applicants interested in bilingual positions may be required to successfully complete a Spanish language proficiency examination. Options: Yes, I am interested in bilingual positions. | I am not interested in bilingual positions.

04. What work schedules are you interested in? (Select ALL that apply.) Positions vary in daily work hours. Please select all schedules you would be willing to accept. Options: Less than 4 hours per day | 4 hours or more | No preference - I am open to any schedule.

05. How many years of professional clerical or secretarial experience do you have? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year of experience | 1 year but less than 2 years of experience | 2 years but less than 3 years experience | 3 or more years of experience

06. What is your tested typing speed? Options: less than 20 words per minute | 20-25 words per minute | 26-30 words per minute | 31-35 words per minute | 36-40 words per minute | More than 40 words per minute | I do not know my current typing speed.

07. Have you completed a typing test and uploaded a typing certificate with your application? Typing certificates must be dated within 60 days prior to the date of application submission and indicate your net typing speed (WPM). If you do not currently have a qualifying certificate, you may submit one during the examination process. Options: Yes, I completed a typing test within the last 60 days and uploaded my certificate. | No, my typing certificate is older than 60 days, and I will retake the test and submit an updated certificate at a later date. | No, I have not completed a typing test and will need to take one.
